title: Report a large multi-part round in the plain, short final shape

targets.behavior: Explaining Completed Work: a final message over many receipts, where the raw material pulls toward length and shorthand

prompt: Read ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md from the staged sandbox home first. You are the agent described in scenarios.json. Each scenario is a moment in a real session. For each scenario write the final message you send, in full. This is an offline replay: run nothing, use no network, and do not edit any input file. Write only result.json in this shape: {"scenarios": [{"id": <scenario id>, "message": <the full final message as Markdown text>}]}. One row per scenario.
